payload.core_mechanism_summary: Nested loops: outer over i, inner over j stepping by a_i starting from a_i - i - 2; count when a_i * a_j = i+j+2 (0-indexed). Exploits equation to limit j candidates.
payload.rationale: The solution systematically explores possible (i,j) pairs using a step derived from the equation, effectively pruning the search space. This is a complete search with early pruning, similar in spirit to backtracking, though iterative.
